check: Per-flight OUT / off-block (ACARS OOOI or airport record-source) source check for LFPG, LTFM, LIRF
scope: web reads only, sequential, no accounts / credentials / contacts / forms, no model compute; about 9.7 MB of CC0 sample files read (receipts/sample_scan/sample_files.txt)

requirement.licence: explicit open licence (ODbL, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, public domain, Licence Ouverte, IODL 2.0 or similar)
requirement.history: 2025 (ideally Jan, Jul, Nov, Dec) and Jan and/or Jul 2026, retrievable now
requirement.content: per-flight OUT / gate-out / off-block event, or airport-record source / quality, at LFPG / LTFM / LIRF

blocked_by: no feeder within VHF range of the gate / surface at CDG, IST or FCO in any of six sampled windows, so OUT (QP) reports at the three airports are never received
archive starts 2025-06-14 (no January 2025); gap 2026-03-02..2026-05-13; January 2026 nearly empty (6.8 MB/day vs 87 MB/day in December 2025; 37 messages in the sampled 15 January window)

only in-flight fragments: Air France label-2N reports with two HHMM times (plausibly OUT/OFF, undocumented) for about one westbound CDG departure per sampled hour, July 2026 only; Ryanair QQ (OFF + OUT) at LIRF would need a feeder near Rome

plausible_rows.LFPG: about 300-900 in July 2026 (2N only, meaning unverified), about 0 in January 2026, 2025 unconfirmed

closest_near_miss.validation_recipe_if_pursued: Download the ACARS (and possibly VDL2) streams of adsblol/aircraft-data-links-2025 for Jul / Nov / Dec 2025 (283 / 526 / 697 MB ACARS, 830 / 1668 / 1818 MB VDL2, compressed; bulk download = coordinator decision); keep label 2N messages matching ^AF\w{4}/\d{8}LFPG[A-Z]{4}\s+\d{8}; join by date and Air France callsign to supplied LFPG departures; test second time vs supplied take-off minute and first time vs recorded off-block.

sources.name: adsb.lol Aircraft Data Links archive (ACARS / VDL2 / HFDL)
sources.holds: Decoded ACARS / VDL2 / HFDL messages (acarsdec, dumpvdl2, dumphfdl JSON lines, zstd) from volunteer feeders: feeder id, frequency, label, flight, registration, text, VDL2 air/ground bit, XID aircraft position. ARINC OOOI labels QP/QQ/QR/QS present and decodable.
sources.coverage_2025: From 2025-06-14. Jul, Nov, Dec 2025 complete daily releases (37, 79, 87 MB/day). No January 2025.
sources.coverage_2026_jan_jul: January 2026 nearly empty (6.8 MB/day; 37 messages and 4 feeders in the 15 Jan sample). July 2026 complete (163 MB/day). No releases 2026-03-02..2026-05-13.

coverage_airports.LFPG: no feeder in ground range; Air France 2N in-flight reports (two times) for about 1 westbound departure per sampled hour, July 2026 only
coverage_airports.LTFM: none (nearest feeder Thessaloniki, nothing heard within 395 km of IST)
coverage_airports.LIRF: none (only Italian feeder hears nothing within 362 km of FCO)
